استمجدوا (form X)
# اِسْتَمْجَدُوا (istamjadū) /is.tam.d͡ʒa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# اُسْتُمْجِدُوا (ustumjidū) /us.tum.d͡ʒi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# اِسْتَمْجِدُوا (istamjidū) /is.tam.d͡ʒi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
